description:
Start a new property listing in YOUR agency's CRM from a description.
Use when the agent is describing a property they have taken on and
wants it in the system.

Creates a DRAFT. It is never published and never appears on the
portal from here: the agent adds photographs and the energy rating
in the CRM and publishes it themselves. The response includes a
direct link to the draft.

Location is resolved against the real area tree, so a town,
suburb or urbanisation name is enough. Requires a linked
PropertyList account (or an agency API key).

description.description: The property description, in the language the agent wrote it.

headline.description: Short headline for the listing. Optional.

language.description: Language the description is written in. Defaults to the agency language.

location.description: Town, suburb or urbanisation, e.g. "Nueva Andalucia" or "Menara Beach".

price.description: Asking price in euros, or monthly rent for a rental.

property_type.description: apartment, villa, penthouse, townhouse, plot or commercial.

search_type.description: Whether it is for sale or for long-term rent. Defaults to for-sale.

name: create_listing

location.description: Where the draft was filed; null when the place name matched no area.

url.description: The draft in the CRM, where the agent finishes and publishes it.

warning.description: Advice to pass on to the agent before they publish.

title: Create listing draft
